Animal World - Big Cats.name: Animal World: Big Cats
Animal World - Big Cats.summary: Test your knowledge about cats by reading all about cats and different lions, and then answer the questions (Basic Image and Written) to earn trophies that expands your facts about them.

Bakugan - Rise of the Resistance.name: Bakugan: Rise of the Resistance
Bakugan - Rise of the Resistance.summary: It is based on the Bakugan anime season, Bakugan Battle Brawlers: New Vestroia. The new battle mode uses a new fighting engine similar to that of a Tower Defense game.

CSI - Crime Scene Investigation - Dark M.name: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Dark Motives
CSI - Crime Scene Investigation - Dark M.summary: 369 Interactive's second attempt at recreating the CSI: Crime Scene Investigation show in a game. This is the second CSI game for the PC and is the first CSI game for the Nintendo DS.

Eyeshield 21 - Max Devil Power!.name: Eyeshield 21: MAX Devil Power
Eyeshield 21 - Max Devil Power!.summary: Based on the Eyeshield 21 anime, MAX Devil Power follows Sena and the Deimon Devil Bats as they recruit new members for the team while facing off against the best of Japan's high school division of American football.

James Cameron's Avatar - The Game.name: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game
James Cameron's Avatar - The Game.summary: DS Port of James Cameron's Avatar: The Game is the official video game based on the highly anticipated film James Cameron's Avatar.

Lingo Deluxe.name: Lingo Deluxe
Lingo Deluxe.summary: Lingo Deluxe is a Nintendo DS game based on the Dutch game show Lingo.

Major League Baseball 2K9 - Fantasy All-.name: Major League Baseball 2K9: Fantasy All-Stars
Major League Baseball 2K9 - Fantasy All-.summary: Major League Baseball 2K9 is a portable spin-off of the MLB 2K series. It features a less-realistic portrayal of the game of baseball, with cartoonish settings and characters.

Need for Speed - Underground 2.name: Need for Speed: Underground 2
Need for Speed - Underground 2.summary: Dual-screen driving takes to the streets! Taking advantage of the Nintendo DS' powerful capabilities, this racer features some of the most detailed car models and impressive environments you'll ever play on the go. The racing action is displayed on the top screen, while the lower screen features a map of the current circuit to help you keep track of the track. You can use the touch screen to fire off a nitrous boost effect, or else customize your ride any way you choose. Plus, use the in-built paint program and stylus to create your own designs, and pimp your ride accordingly! Compete against other street racers, or play your friends - up to four players can race wirelessly against each other in the game's multiplayer mode. With a hip-hop soundtrack and 15 licensed motors, street racing doesn't get any more ferocious.

Puzzle Kingdoms.name: Puzzle Kingdoms
Puzzle Kingdoms.summary: Puzzle Kingdoms challenges players to plan out strategic attacks in order to defeat their opponents. Order troops across the map, conquering cities through innovative puzzle gameplay. Players build and manage armies led by heroic commanders to save the world of Etheria from the brink of destruction. By matching corresponding gems on the game board, players will both inflict damage on enemy forces while building mana that can be used to perform devastating attacks that will cripple their opponents.

Puzzle Series Vol. 11 - Nurikabe.name: Puzzle Series Vol. 11: Nurikabe
Puzzle Series Vol. 11 - Nurikabe.summary: A number puzzle named after the wall yōkai of the same name.

Sonic Colors.name: Sonic Colors
Sonic Colors.summary: An extraordinary amusement park has been seen orbiting around the home planet of Sonic the Hedgehog, and rumors are spreading that an alien race of Wisps, who have a unique colorful energy, are being held captive there by the evil Dr. Eggman. Soon after arriving at the amusement park, Sonic discovers he is able to use these mysterious alien forces to help the Wisps escape!

Suite Life of Zack & Cody, The - Circle.name: The Suite Life of Zack & Cody: Circle of Spies
Suite Life of Zack & Cody, The - Circle.summary: Join Zack and Cody on their second adventure on the DS.

Tecmo Bowl - Kickoff.name: Tecmo Bowl: Kickoff
Tecmo Bowl - Kickoff.summary: The DS entry in the venerable Tecmo Bowl franchise, featuring playbook and stat customization, special player abilities, and dramatic cutscenes in the style of Tecmo Super Bowl.

Treasure Report - Kikai Jikake no Isan.name: Treasure Report: Kikai Jikake no Isan
Treasure Report - Kikai Jikake no Isan.summary: Treasure Report: Kikai Jikake no Isan is a Puzzle game, developed by Matrix Software and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Urbz, The - Sims in the City.name: The Urbz: Sims in the City
